title: Add support for easy mode
body:
This branch adds support for an "easy" mode w/ larger, slower moving targets for less skilled users. The effects of late warp may not be as pronounced, but this should provide an option for people less experienced in FPS gameplay.

You can set easy mode using the existing `mode` URL param as follows (though this link will not actually work until this PR is merged): 
[https://nvlabs.github.io/FPSWarpDemo?mode=easy](https://nvlabs.github.io/FPSWarpDemo?mode=easy)

In the meantime you can test it using `[repo location]/index.html?mode=easy`

title: Improved results display
body:
The results display font color is now improved and the app exits pointer lock/first person control when displaying results to allow users to capture results without a key bound print screen.

Keeping this as a draft PR for now baring color approval and any other suggestions we might have for usability of the results display.

title: Invert Y
body: This branch adds support for Y inversion from training sessions either using a checkbox or by pressing the "I" key on the keyboard.

title: fix(fps): referenceTarget flag never reset after reference (+2 more)
fix: browser may open before HTTP server is ready
body:
### Problem
fix: browser may open before HTTP server is ready

### Fix
Replace:
```
start py -m http.server 8000 
start http://localhost:8000/index.html
```

with:
```
start py -m http.server 8000 
timeout /t 1 /nobreak >nul
start http://localhost:8000/index.html
```

- `open_localhost.bat`
